name: Fujimiya Haruka
source:
A purple haired-girl who has a very bad attitude. She is very shy, careless and freaky. Haruka has a younger twin sister, [url=http://vndb.org/c11345]Natsuki[/url], who is a member of the student council. The two twin sisters may look alike, but their personalities are completely different.

[From [url=http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Maple_Colors_2]Wikipedia[/url].]
